metadata.source: City of Toronto 2025 8 cm aerial imagery

label_contract.positive: Existing documentary CONFIRMED cooling-tower property, not pixel-verified current tower.
label_contract.control: Original POC property without confirmed tower evidence; absence of evidence is not a true negative.
label_contract.interpretation: Scores measure visual similarity to weak documentary labels and MUST NOT create or upgrade tower confirmation.
label_contract.imagery_date: 2025 imagery can post-date or pre-date individual construction/removal events.

weak_label_validation.warning: These are discrimination metrics against weak documentary labels, not validated cooling-tower detection accuracy.
